headline: Core banking margin expands and profit edges higher

kpis.label: Core Banking net interest income change

summary_short: Net income rose 4% y/y to $31.1M and diluted EPS rose 5% to $1.59; Core Banking net interest income grew 8% and its margin widened 25bp to 4.03%.
summary_long: Management credits strong core loan growth, lower funding costs, a favorable shift in earning assets, disciplined pricing and balance sheet management. A new Republic Payment Solutions program generated about $180M of lower-cost average deposits in the quarter. The Federal Reserve raised rates 25bp on September 16, 2026; management expects the higher-rate environment to add to Core Bank net interest income near term. The release gives no numeric guidance.
confidence_notes: Shard sourceLink was a Yahoo fallback page; the press release was found by web search (EDGAR exhibit). The shard's prior-year EPS (1.17 from Yahoo) does not match the release's $1.52 for Q3 2025; the release figure is used. NIM of 4.03% is for the Core Banking segment, not consolidated. Segment tables and credit-quality detail were not read.

drivers.explanation: Lower funding costs, a favorable shift in earning assets, disciplined pricing actions and proactive balance sheet management.
CEO cites strong loan growth across core markets and categories, net interest income expansion, disciplined expenses and solid credit quality.
New Republic Payment Solutions program added about $180 million of lower-cost average deposits and incremental fee income.
